title: This frame is HORRIBLE!!
text: This frame is HORRIBLE!!. This frame is just awful!!  The wood part is just plain & fine.  But it does NOT even have a glass for over the picture!!  It is just a thin piece of plastic! I had to add 3 pieces of cardboard to fill the gap so the back would stay on!!!  I am SO SO DISAPPOINTED!!!  I would not pay $1 for it,  and I paid $7.19.  NOT WORTH THE MONEY!!!  I do NOT recommend this at all!!  Don't even waste your money!!!!  P.S.  I did get a FULL refund from the company!  SO I am very pleased that they stand by their products!!!!

product_metadata.title: FaCraft 2020 Merry Christmas Photo Frame,Christmas Decorations 8x10 Black (Love)
